SHADOW pre-reg (v9 candidate #2): filter_path_z. Take-filter (restrictive) that takes ONLY when session=NY AND direction=SHORT AND ER_5m_20<0.30 AND dow in Mon-Tue-Wed. Discovered via scripts/deep_analysis_orb.py on Dukascopy XAU/USD 5m 2024-2026 (n=1018). Path Y overall lost -$25,249 but NY-SHORT+LowER+Mon-Wed subset (n=91) has mean +$409/trade, 62.6% win rate, bootstrap 95% CI [+$45,+$760] clears zero. Mechanism identified: winners come on 25% wider OR + asymmetric payoff (winner mean +$1,233 vs loser mean -$971 = 1.27:1). Real yield IDENTICAL across winners/losers (not macro-regime edge). Sign confirmed on real GC 5m yfinance n=31 (NY-SHORT +$36/trade, only positive quadrant). Concentration risk documented: top 5 trades = 64% of P&L. Ship gate: n>=100 shadow-taken AND mean>0 AND CI clears 0 AND win rate>=55% AND Bonferroni-adjusted DSR passes AND fresh Path Z-specific SPRT pre-reg. Reject gate: mean<=0, or CI includes 0 with mean<+$50, or win rate<55%, or hard-stop 2026-10-13. Fails 3-months-ago test (discovered from analyzing today's sample). Bonferroni-N increments +6-8 for today's segmentation multiplicity. Full pre-reg: docs/experiments/2026-07-20_path_z_ny_short_prereg.md. No live effect (require_path_z=False in all live configs). AMENDMENT 2026-07-22: ship-gate #5 changed from Bonferroni-DSR>0.95 (structurally infeasible for fat-tail Path Z; per-trade SR 0.222 vs SR* 1.485 at N=32 V=0.5) to PSR vs SR=0 > 0.95 on forward n>=100 sample. Full rationale: docs/experiments/2026-07-22_path_z_ship_gate_amendment.md. Current in-sample PSR = 0.9858 (clears). FORMAL RETIREMENT 2026-07-22: 9-year OOS test on 2015-2023 Dukascopy XAUUSD (n=288) showed mean +$2.58/trade, WR 44.1% (below 55% gate), Sharpe R=-0.039. Path Z is a 2025-2026 gold-rally regime anomaly, not a persistent edge. 9 of 12 years near-flat/losing. Combined 12yr sample n=373 with mean +$107/week barely clears bootstrap CI. Retired per pre-reg reject gate: OOS mean/WR falls below thresholds when broader sample is tested. Full: memory/path_z_oos_result.md. Ship-gate 6 (Path Z SPRT pre-reg sprt_path_z_live) also becomes DEPRECATED as dependency chain is now dead.

Options-selling income (BSM 5-delta puts on gold weekly, GVZ as IV). Fresh mechanism family. Primary spec (delta 0.05) OOS 2019-2026: Sharpe -0.30, total -$17,123, WR 96.6%, skew -8.51, max weekly loss -$22k. 2/7 gates pass. Kill switch on negative Sharpe. Sensitivity: delta 0.10 → 3/7 gates (Sharpe -0.09), delta 0.15 → 5/7 gates (Sharpe 0.09) — but choosing best delta post-hoc = curve fit. Skewness -8.5 to -6.4 across all delta variants = catastrophic left tail. Not shippable. Volatility risk premium on gold appears too small to justify tail exposure in modeled backtest. Real GLD/GC options may differ (skew premium) but pre-reg was pure BSM.

LogReg on 8 features (M20, M60, MA_ratio, ATR_pct, RY_chg, DXY_chg, GVZ_z, nc_z). 26-week walk-forward CV expanding window from 2019. 15 folds. OOS: 175 non-flat trades, WR 49.1%, total -$48,726, Sharpe 0.08, PSR 0.56. 2/7 gates pass (only n and folds count). Kill switch: worst fold Sharpe -9.16 in 2026 blowup (n=15, all LONG, -$85k in single fold). Model was directionally sensible in 2020-2022 (WR 60-77%) but couldn't adapt to 2026 regime shift. Third and final mechanism family from user brief tried and rejected.

Put-spread variant of C1 (short 5-delta + long 2-delta). Improved over naked-put: max loss capped $6.6k (was $22k), Sharpe +0.08 (was -0.30), total +$2,563 (was -$17k). 4/7 gates pass. Kill switch triggered: skew -6.73 < -4. Cap helped but structural issue remains — weekly premium (~$50) is too small to survive individual assignments ($1000-$6000). Options mechanism family on gold weekly definitively closed.

Silver volatility regime signal. Pre-reg baseline: 20d ann vol; LOW<25%=SHORT above MA20 (mean-revert); HIGH>40%=LONG on MA10 upcross (breakout); MED=FLAT. Stop=2*ATR(20), hold=15d. Result: n=192, mean R=-0.055, CI=[-0.227,0.122], p_adj=1.0, verdict INDIST. LOW-regime SHORTs bleed (silver drifts up on industrial demand); HIGH-regime breakouts too rare (28 signals, 16yr). 8 robustness variants (vol thresholds, MA lengths, hold periods, regime-change exit) all also INDIST. Rejected. Silver research sweep (3 candidates) exhausted.

Janus funding-extreme transplant to gold via futures basis (GC=F minus XAUUSD spot). Pre-reg baseline: 180d lookback, p95/p5 percentile thresholds, hold=7d, stop=2*ATR(20). n=255 over 17yr. Bootstrap: mean R=+0.079, CI=[-0.047, +0.207], p_adj=0.220, verdict INDIST — misses 0.5% ship threshold and significance. Baseline does NOT ship. HOWEVER: direction split shows LONG-only cut (basis extreme low = physical stress reversal) is much stronger: n=157, mean R=+0.119, total=+$104,410, 13/17 positive years for the tighter p97.5 variant. SHORT side (crowded premium unwind, the direct crypto-funding analog) is dead: mean R=+0.006, total=-$24,755. Follow-up worth pre-registering with LONG-only baseline on fresh OOS split. Robustness sweep also indist but directionally supportive except lookback=365 and hold=15. Total 17yr baseline P&L: +$86,204. Files: scripts/gold_basis_janus_transplant.py.

Fresh pre-reg of LONG-only gold basis mechanism (post-hoc finding from gold_basis_janus_transplant_v1). Train 2010-2017 / OOS 2018-2026 split. TRAIN n=49, mean R +0.033 (break-even). OOS n=54, mean R +0.252, WR 59.3%, DD -2.85R, total +$106K, 7/9 positive years (78%). Bonferroni n=2: CI [-0.033, +0.562], p_adj 0.191, ci_low fails 0.005 threshold. VERDICT: rejected by pre-reg gate (Gate 1 FAIL, Gate 2 PASS). BUT: OOS is directionally strong, just underpowered — small n=54 means large CI even for strong mean. Signal appears regime-dependent (much stronger post-2018). Recommendation: live paper-trade forward for 6-12 months to grow n. If forward n=100+ maintains R~0.15+, consider shipping as companion LONG signal to NORTH v1. Files: scripts/gold_basis_long_only_oos.py.
